title: add-benchmark-lab-performance-suites-reporting-pipeline-v150
author: Priya Nair
description: Context: Benchmark Lab iteration v150 consolidates recent performance test suites, updates profiling baselines, adds representative workload runners for multi-variant inference paths, and wires a reporting pipeline compatible with the new telemetry schema. Motivation: v150 is intended to standardize the reporting format used by perf engineers and SRE to compare kernel-selection experiments and adaptive-batching runs across GPU families. This PR includes pipeline manifests, runner implementations (small, representative workloads), updates to profiling baselines, and dashboard wiring for the reporting pipeline. Changes are backward-compatible with earlier reporting pipelines but introduce a new 'kernel_profile_v2' metric that downstream dashboards will consume. Checklist: - [x] Add reporting pipeline manifests for v150 - [x] Implement representative workload runners for text-gen, chat-turns, and embeddings mixed loads - [x] Update profiling baseline protobuf and exporters - [x] Add terraform monitoring integration and alert rule for perf-regression - [x] Update docs and runbooks - [x] CI and integration test pass Summary of changes: - New pipeline manifest: benchmark-lab/pipelines/reporting/v150.yaml - Runner: benchmark-lab/runners/representative/runners_v4.py (adds multivariant workload configs and deterministic seeds for reproducibility) - Profiling baselines: benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines/v150_baselines.json (includes kernel_profile_v2 snapshots) - Telemetry/metrics: infra/telemetry/exporters/kernel_profile_v2_exporter.py - Terraform: infra/terraform/monitoring.tf (alert for >5% median latency regression across canary) - Docs: docs/benchmark-lab/README.md and docs/benchmark-lab/runbook-v150.md Testing & validation: - Unit tests for runner scheduler and exporter (pytest) - Integration runs in benchmark-lab CI using small GPU job class (ci:benchmark-small) - End-to-end smoke run: generated representative-run artifacts validated against v150 baseline locally and in the canary reporting namespace Rollout plan: - Merge to main, deploy pipeline in canary namespace, run 5 representative workloads, validate metrics and traces, then promote to prod reporting namespace. Limitations & notes: - kernel_profile_v2 is additive and will be ignored by older dashboards until they are updated. - The new exporters add 1-2% overhead in collection during profiling runs; this is acceptable for baseline collection but should be disabled for tight latency experiments. Related: ENG-1987 (kernel selection profiling), ENG-2041 (adaptive-batching telemetry), previous work pr-680321 (kernel-selection-profiling-reporting-pipeline).
